parameters.description: A new description, as HTML. Leave empty to keep the current one.

update_product_variant.description: Change one variant's price, 'was' price, SKU, barcode, tax or stock tracking. Only the fields you fill in change.

parameters.description: The product. Pick a recent one, use one from an earlier step, or paste the number at the end of its page's address in the Shopify admin.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: The variant to change, from List product variants.

parameters.description: The new selling price, in the store's currency, without a currency symbol.

description: Run your Shopify store from a workflow: products, stock, orders, shipping, draft orders and customers.

shopify_abandoned_checkout_trigger.description: Runs when a shopper leaves a checkout unfinished for an hour, with what was in their cart and a link back to it, to send a reminder.

output.abandonedCheckoutUrl: The link that takes the shopper back to their cart.
output.customer: The shopper: id, displayName, firstName, lastName, email and phone, when known.
output.email: The shopper's email address, blank when they gave none.
output.name: The checkout's name, such as #1234.
output.products: What was in the cart: title, variant, quantity and sku (the first ten).
output.shippingAddress: Where it was to ship to, if they got that far.
output.subtotalPriceSet: The subtotal, as shopMoney.amount and shopMoney.currencyCode.
output.totalPriceSet: The total, as shopMoney.amount and shopMoney.currencyCode.
output.total_display: The total as a person writes it, such as $84.00. Use it in a message.
output.updatedAt: When the shopper last changed it.

shopify_customer_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a customer in your store changes: their details, tags, marketing choice or address, or when they place an order.

output.accepts_marketing: Beta. True when they agreed to marketing emails, false when they didn't or haven't said.
output.state: Their account state, such as ENABLED or DISABLED.
output.updatedAt: When it was last changed: the change this run is for.

shopify_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added to your store, whether they sign up, check out for the first time or are added by your team.

output.accepts_marketing: Beta. True when they agreed to marketing emails, false when they didn't or haven't said.
output.state: Their account state, such as ENABLED or DISABLED.

parameters.description: Beta. Enter yes to run only for customers who agreed to marketing emails, so a welcome series or a mailing list never gets someone who did not. Leave empty to run for every new customer.
parameters.name: only_accepts_marketing

shopify_new_order_trigger.description: Runs when an order is placed in your store, paid or not. Use Order paid to run only once the money is in.

output.customer: The customer: id, displayName, firstName, lastName, email, phone and numberOfOrders (their orders in your store so far, this one included: 1 means a first-time customer). Empty for a guest checkout, whose name is then blank: use the order's email to say who ordered.
output.displayFinancialStatus: Payment status, such as PAID or PENDING.
output.displayFulfillmentStatus: Shipping status, such as UNFULFILLED or FULFILLED.
output.fulfilled_at: When its latest shipment was made; empty if none.
output.fulfillments: Its shipments, each with status and trackingInfo. An order shipped in parts has one per part.
output.legacyResourceId: The order's number in the admin's address bar.
output.name: The order's name customers see, such as #1001.
output.paid_at: When its latest payment went through; empty if unpaid.
output.products: The line items: title, quantity, sku and total (the first ten).
output.subtotalPriceSet: The subtotal, as shopMoney.amount and shopMoney.currencyCode.
output.test: Whether it is a test order.
output.totalPriceSet: The total, as shopMoney.amount and shopMoney.currencyCode.
output.total_display: The total as a person writes it, such as $1,240.50. Use it in a message.

parameters.description: Only run for orders whose total is at least this much, in the store's currency (500 means $500). Leave empty to run for every order.
parameters.name: minimum_total

shopify_new_product_trigger.description: Runs when a product is added to your store, whether it's published straight away or saved as a draft, with its title, price and stock.

output.handle: The end of its web address, such as cotton-t-shirt.
output.legacyResourceId: The product's number in the admin's address bar.
output.onlineStoreUrl: Its page in your online store, empty until published.
output.priceRangeV2: Its lowest and highest variant prices.
output.title: Its title.
output.totalInventory: How many are in stock across all locations.
